info.description: API-first, graph-native source of truth for modular data centers.
info.title: Orbital API

get.description:
Read-only, immutable audit trail of intent mutations, newest first.

**Scope a query** by combining filters: `orbId` (repeatable, max 32) for a specific resource; `namespace` for a whole data center; `resource_type`/`operation_name` to narrow. To see everything under a server/cluster, fetch its subtree orbIds from the GraphQL Topology API and pass them as repeatable `orbId` params (there is no single "cluster" scope — a child mutation records the child's orbId, not the parent's).

**Render a diff:** when an event is a clean single-entity update it carries a `changes` array (`[{field, before, after}]`) with metadata and DGraph UIDs already excluded — render it directly. When `changes` is absent (bulk add, create, or a multi-operation event), there is no field diff; fall back to showing `operations` + `resourceIds`. The raw `details` (with `before`/`variables`) is always included for callers that want it.

Returns JSON by default; returns an HTML table fragment when the `HX-Request` header is present (used by orbital's own UI). See docs/api-cheatsheet.md § "Audit log".

parameters.description: Filter by resource orbId (e.g. alaska-dot:GRTLY24). Repeatable (pass multiple), max 32 — matches events touching ANY of them.
parameters.name: orbId

parameters.description: RFC3339 lower bound (exclusive) on event timestamp
parameters.name: since

parameters.description: RFC3339 upper bound (inclusive) on event timestamp
parameters.name: until

parameters.description: Filter by resource type (e.g. Server, DataCenter)
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.description: Filter to events containing this operation (exact, case-sensitive; stored form is verb-lowercased, e.g. updateVeleroBackup)
parameters.name: operation_name

post.description: Triggers an async DGraph backup to configured S3-compatible or Azure Blob storage. Returns immediately with a job ID. Returns 409 if a backup is already in progress.

get.description: Returns up to 50 backup records ordered by most recent first.
Returns the current status and metadata for a single backup job.

delete.description: Deletes the backup record and its archive from storage. Returns 409 if the backup is still running.

get.description: Returns a presigned URL (valid 15 minutes) to download the completed backup archive. Returns 404 if the job is not completed or has no archive.

post.description: Pings the configured backup storage backend (S3-compatible or Azure Blob). Returns JSON `{ok, error?}` by default, or an inline HTML span when `HX-Request: true` is set.

delete.description:
Deletes a DataCenter or Server together with its dependent
children. Bound to the UI delete modal's confirm action.
Single-entity (non-cascading) deletes go through GraphQL.

parameters.description: Filter by resolution action; repeatable for OR
parameters.name: action

delete.summary: Clear all divergence state for a data center

409.description: MVCC conflict — intent changed since report

post.description: Triggers an async atomic export of the data center's configuration subgraph. When download=false (default) AND OCI is configured, the export chains into an OCI publish and the zip is discarded on completion. When download=true (or OCI is not configured), the export runs in download-only mode and the zip is retained on disk for the client to fetch via GET /api/v1/export/jobs/{jobId}/download. Returns 202 with a job ID immediately; poll GET /api/v1/export/jobs/{jobId} until terminal state. Returns 409 if an export or restore is already in progress, or if expectedContentHash is supplied and the desired state changed since that preview (guarded Apply).

get.description: Returns the desired-state delta between two published OCI artifacts of the same data center. Read-only; both artifacts are pulled by immutable digest. Not an apply-forecast.

parameters.description: Artifact ID to diff FROM (the earlier side)
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Artifact ID to diff TO (the later side)
parameters.name: to

get.description: Returns the 50 most recent export jobs ordered by creation time.
Returns the current status of an export job.

delete.description: Removes the retained zip for a download-flow export. The ExportJob row remains for audit; only the on-disk artifact and artifact_path are cleared. 404 if job or artifact does not exist.

get.description: Downloads a zip containing data.json.gz + schema.gz. When bundlers are configured, also includes bundler-produced layers + layers.json — the exact format orb's /import/artifact accepts.

post.description: Synchronous, read-only. Diffs the current desired state for a data center against its last published artifact. Not an apply-forecast.
post.summary: Preview export diff (desired-state delta vs last published)

get.description: Returns published OCI artifacts, most recent first. Combine `dc` + `status=completed` + `limit=1` to read the latest published version for a data center — the response carries `tag`, `digest` and `completedAt`. **Compare on `digest`, not `tag`:** the tag sequence is per OCI repository and the repository name derives from the data center's editable name, so renaming a data center restarts the sequence at v1 for the same orbId.

parameters.description: Filter by data center orbId (e.g. colo:colo-galleon). Matches RegistryArtifact.datacenter_id, which stores the orbId.
parameters.name: dc

parameters.description: Filter by publish status (e.g. completed). Only completed artifacts have a retrievable digest.
parameters.name: status

get.description: Returns a single OCI artifact record by ID.
Returns an HTML fragment rendering the layers modal for the given artifact.
get.summary: Get layers for an OCI artifact

get.description: Returns the PEM-encoded public key corresponding to the configured OCI signing key. Used by edge consumers to verify artifact signatures.

post.description: Pings the configured OCI registry to verify credentials and reachability. Returns {"ok": true} on success or {"ok": false, "error": "..."} on failure.
Restores DGraph blue from a stored backup. Blocked if any backup, export, or restore job is in progress.

get.description: Returns up to 50 restore jobs ordered by most recent first.
Returns the status of a specific restore job.
Returns all users in the orbital user table. Admin only.

put.description: Changes a user's role. Accepts `readonly`, `dev`, or `admin`. Admin only. Returns 409 if changing the role would leave zero admins (last-admin guard).

post.description: POST: proxies GraphQL queries and mutations to DGraph. GET: serves the GraphiQL explorer UI.

total.description: Total is the count of events matching the filters, ignoring limit/offset.

trigger.description:
Trigger records what initiated the backup: "manual" (default) or
"scheduled". Optional — an empty body is treated as "manual".

resolution.description: Resolution is the current decision on this entry, if any. Nil when un-resolved.

error.example: dev or admin role required for mutations

hint.example: Ask an admin to grant you the dev role.

changes.description:
Changes is the pre-computed field-level diff. **Present ONLY for a clean
single-entity update** (omitted otherwise via omitempty) — so its presence
is the client's signal that a field diff is available; no need to inspect
operations/before. Server-managed metadata (version/updatedAt/updatedBy/…)
and DGraph UIDs are already excluded. Same data the UI's colored diff renders.

download.description:
Download selects the mode. false (default) exports and publishes to OCI,
discarding the zip on completion. true exports only and retains the zip
for GET /api/v1/export/jobs/{jobId}/download.

expectedContentHash.description:
ExpectedContentHash is the optional guarded-Apply token: pass the
`current.contentHash` from a prior POST /api/v1/export/preview and the
export aborts with 409 if the data center's desired state changed since
that preview (another writer edited intent in the review→Apply gap).
Omit for last-writer-wins (default, back-compatible). This is the
ETag/If-Match pattern applied to a whole subgraph — one hash rather than
per-node version checks, so concurrent ADDS and DELETES are caught too.

orbId.description: OrbID identifies the data center to export, in "namespace:name" form. Required.

backupId.description: BackupID is the UUID of the stored backup to restore from. Required.

confirmSchemaMismatch.description:
ConfirmSchemaMismatch must be true to proceed when the backup's schema
version differs from the running schema. false (default) makes such a
restore fail fast rather than risk a mismatched load.

phase.description:
Phase surfaces the fine-grained step the atomic goroutine is on, for
clients that want to render a per-step progress list. Coarse `status`
stays authoritative for terminal-state gating. Values: pending,
exporting, bundling, pushing, signing, completed, failed. Empty
only if derivation raced with the initial insert.

isOrbitalNative.description: true for data.json.gz + schema.gz; false for anything bundler-added

producer.description:
Producer is the friendly name of whatever produced this layer (e.g.
"orbital" for the two graph layers, "configbundle-bundler" for layers
returned by that bundler). Mirrors the OCI manifest annotation
`com.armada.orbital.producer` written at push time. Empty for legacy
artifacts published before producer attribution was introduced.
